integrity: Closed-form formula supported by a proof based on connected tight graphs and explicit finite distinguished-triple classification; rational checks supplement, do not replace universal proof.
scientific_limitations: Facet number only; two incident short distances with 0<r,s<1 and r+s>=1, all other pairwise distances one, N>=4. End faces r=1 or s=1 and complete face lattice are excluded. Possible equivalent unindexed prior literature has not been eliminated.
title: Four facet-count chambers for two adjacent shortened distances
